screen.title: Yachashpa ari nina
screen.registerSubtitle: Wawata killkakatinamanta ñawpaka kayta ñawinchiy. Paypak willaykunata wakaychinkapak, rikunkapakpash ari ninami kan.
screen.documentInSpanish: Kamachik killkaka ishpañol shimipimi rikurin, tikrachishkata allichikukpi.
